name.en: SCO Heads of State Council Summit 2027
name.zh: 2027年上海合作組織元首理事會峰會

next_meeting.note: 2026 summit already held in Bishkek (31 Aug-1 Sep 2026). Pakistan chairs 2026-27; Islamabad/Sept 2027 per press reports, not officially dated.

title.zh: 比斯凱克峰會通過宣言

summary.en: The 26th SCO summit in Bishkek on 1 September 2026 adopted the Bishkek Declaration and 28 documents, covering security, AI, energy and transport.
summary.zh: 2026年9月1日於比斯凱克舉行的第26屆上合峰會通過《比斯凱克宣言》等28份文件，涵蓋安全、人工智慧、能源與交通。

question.en: Is the SCO mainly a security club or an economic bloc?
question.zh: 上合組織主要是安全組織，還是經濟集團？

title.en: Plans for an SCO Development Bank

summary.en: Russia proposed an SCO Development Bank, backed by several members, and Kazakhstan offered Astana as its headquarters; the bank's location is not settled.
summary.zh: 俄羅斯提議成立上合開發銀行，獲數個成員支持，哈薩克提議總部設於阿斯塔納；地點尚未定案。

question.en: Why might countries want development banks outside the World Bank and IMF system?
question.zh: 為什麼有些國家想在世界銀行與IMF體系之外另設開發銀行？

title.zh: 巴基斯坦接任上合主席國

summary.en: Pakistan took over the one-year SCO presidency after Bishkek, its first time, and plans to host the 2027 summit in Islamabad.
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦在比斯凱克峰會後首次接任為期一年的上合主席國，計劃於伊斯蘭堡主辦2027年峰會。

question.en: How might India-Pakistan tensions affect an organization where both are members?
question.zh: 印巴緊張關係會如何影響兩國同為成員的組織？

text.en: 'Shanghai Five' formed by China, Russia and three Central Asian states
text.zh: 中、俄與中亞三國組成「上海五國」

text.en: SCO founded in Shanghai; Uzbekistan joins
text.zh: 上合組織於上海成立，烏茲別克加入
簽署《上海合作組織憲章》

text.en: Secretariat opens in Beijing; anti-terror centre in Tashkent
text.zh: 北京秘書處與塔什干反恐機構啟用

text.en: India and Pakistan become full members
text.zh: 印度與巴基斯坦成為正式成員
白俄羅斯成為第10個成員國

text.en: Tianjin summit decides single 'SCO Partner' status
text.zh: 天津峰會決定設立單一「上合夥伴」地位
